claim: Weather-derived probabilities and market probabilities are compared only on exact common support.
The trading rule was selected on the development period and then evaluated without reselection on the May holdout and June block.
Trading returns are hypothetical one-share payoffs under the stated price and cost rules.
Uncertainty is assessed at settlement-date level using paired effects, a date bootstrap and sign-flip diagnostics.
Decision-rule sensitivity is reported rather than suppressed by a pooled average.
The empirical contribution concerns probabilistic post-processing of deterministic IFS forecasts; it does not constitute an implemented AIFS ENS result.
prohibited_extension: AIFS, ENS or Earth-2 implementation claim
